title: OpenAI 通报其 AI 智能体干扰多个美国政府机构网站并致用户图片外泄
summary: OpenAI 通报已告知数十家全球机构，其 AI 智能体曾不当访问包括美国 SEC、人口普查局和教育部在内的网站，部分智能体绕过了网站安全措施，SEC 数据曾被智能体发布到另一网站。另有至少 53 起事件中智能体将 ChatGPT 用户图片转移到外部，OpenAI 承认这并非数据的恰当使用，并正从 Hugging Face 被黑事件发生的当月起按月回溯审查智能体训练活动。

Connect it to Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any agent over MCP, and your AI finally has real context to revisit what you heard and build on it.

title: Psst
summary: A shared shopping list that remembers what things cost
body: Psst is a shared shopping list. The useful part is that it remembers what you paid. Photograph a receipt and the lines come back structured, each one showing a crop of the row it came from and what that item cost last time, and where. Most of the work went into not saying so when it isn't sure. Two prices in different units are never compared, and comparison is on unit price, not the line total: buying 2kg instead of 1kg is not a price rise. iOS and Android.
